description: Fama/French 3 Factors, daily (Mkt-RF, SMB, HML, RF), percent per day, from Kenneth R. French's data library. de Jong et al. (2009) Table VI uses SMB and HML; the market factor is the S&P 500 excess return (from the RD/Shell workbook).
license: Free for research use with attribution (Kenneth R. French data library). Versioned with DVC like all raw data.

F-F_Research_Data_Factors_daily_CSV.zip.md5: recorded at dvc add (data/raw/french_ff.dvc); copy it here when the file is added

known_issues: The library revises history when CRSP is updated: the factors differ slightly from those the paper used (2006-07 vintage). The md5 pins the version used here.
